title: AusXenos: A database of major-element mineral chemistry for Australian mantle xenoliths and xenocrysts
description:
A compilation of major-element mineral chemistry for mantle (and lower-crustal) xenoliths, xenocrysts and diamond inclusions from Australia, together with locality information and eruption ages for their host rocks. The database contains 11,110 samples/grains from 66 localities, with olivine, orthopyroxene, clinopyroxene, garnet and spinel analyses compiled from more than 50 sources. It is provided as a master spreadsheet (AusXenos.xlsx) and plain-text CSV versions, with BibTeX entries for all cited references.

This compilation was undertaken as part of Geoscience Australia's Resourcing Australia's Prosperity initiative and accompanies Hoggard et al. (2026), Paleothermal structure of the Australian continental lithosphere, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems.
